2026-08-20.content: Starting from August 2026, to provide modern security patches and support for MySQL 8.4 and later, the App Engine flexible environment uses Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 as the built-in sidecar container for connections to Cloud SQL. To use the latest Cloud SQL Auth Proxy container immediately, restart your VMs or deploy a new version of your application.

summary.title: Updated Cloud SQL Auth Proxy for App Engine
summary.summary: App Engine flexible environment is updating its connection to Cloud SQL with the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2, starting August 2026. This ensures modern security patches and support for MySQL 8.4 and later. You can enable the new proxy immediately by restarting your VMs or deploying a new application version.

2026-08-14.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see [Secure minimum TLS](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/flexible/secure-minimum-tls).

summary.title: App Engine TLS Update
summary.summary: To enhance security, App Engine will soon require TLS 1.2 or later for applications. You can opt out until August 2026, after which older TLS versions may be blocked to prevent insecure traffic.

2026-06-29.content:
Support for deploying your existing apps in the flexible environment to Cloud Run using
the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command is in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages). For more information, see [Deploy an App Engine app in the flexible environment to Cloud Run](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/migration-center/run/migrate-app-engine-flexible-to-run).

summary.title: Migrate App Engine flexible to Cloud Run
summary.summary: You can now migrate your App Engine flexible environment applications to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This feature is in Preview and allows for easier deployment of existing apps to a more flexible environment. For detailed instructions, refer to the official documentation.

summary.title: PHP 8.5 runtime now generally available
summary.summary: The PHP 8.5 runtime is now generally available. This new runtime offers enhanced features and performance for your PHP applications.

summary.title: PHP 8.5 runtime now in preview
summary.summary: The PHP 8.5 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine flexible environment. This update brings the latest features and improvements of PHP 8.5 to your applications. We encourage you to try it out and provide feedback during this preview period.

2025-10-20.content:
[Support for TLS version 1.2 and later](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/flexible/secure-minimum-tls),
along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites, is in General Availability (GA).

summary.title: TLS 1.2 Support Now Available
summary.summary: We're happy to announce that support for TLS 1.2 and later is now in General Availability. This update also includes a secure set of cipher suites.

2025-08-07.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. [Update your application settings](https://cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/flexible/secure-minimum-tls) in the App Engine flexible environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).

summary.title: TLS Support Update
summary.summary: Support for TLS 1.1 and earlier is deprecated starting March 2025. Update your App Engine settings to use TLS 1.2 or later.

2025-06-17.content: Support for the [PHP 8.4 runtime](https://cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/flexible/php/runtime) is in [General Availability (GA)](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).

summary.title: PHP 8.4 Runtime Now Available
summary.summary: We are pleased to announce that PHP 8.4 is now generally available for the App Engine flexible environment. This update provides the latest features and improvements for your PHP applications.
